description: This file defines the KpiDao class, a data access object responsible for handling CRUD operations, querying, and business logic related to KPI entities within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking KPI states, utilizing Doctrine ORM features and project-specific traits and classes.

classes.name: KpiDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing KPI entities, providing CRUD, search, and integrity validation functionalities within the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Persists a Kpi entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getKpiById
methods.description: Retrieves a Kpi entity by its ID, returns null if not found or deleted.

methods.name: getExistingKpiIds
methods.description: Checks which provided KPI IDs exist and are not deleted, returning their IDs.

methods.name: getKpiList
methods.description: Returns a list of Kpi entities matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a QueryBuilderWrapper object with filters and sorting based on search parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultKpi
methods.description: Retrieves the default KPI if set.

methods.name: deleteKpi
methods.description: Marks specified KPI IDs as deleted if they are not associated with active performance reviews.

methods.name: unsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Unsets the current default KPI, optionally excluding a specific KPI ID.

methods.name: isKpiEditable
methods.description: Checks if a KPI entity is editable based on whether it is linked to any non-activated review.

methods.name: isKpiDeletable
methods.description: Checks if a KPI entity can be deleted based on whether it is linked to any non-inactive review.
